Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
Dear Methuselahs,

it's on again: The German Vampire Elder Kindred Network (VEKN) determines the Champion of Jyhad 2011.

All VtES-gamers from near or far, from all nations and domains are inivited to join us in the Eternal Struggle in Bad Nauheim. We'd be very glad to meet especially YOU .

Fortunately we were able to have the formidable Jugendhaus Alte Feuerwache in Bad Nauheim for location.

The planned schedule is:

Deutsche Meisterschaft in VtES 2011
Date: 11.12.2011
Constructed, 3 + F, Timelimit max. 2 hours (as usual)
Jugendhaus "Alte Feuerwache"
Johannisstrasse 5
61231 Bad Nauheim

Telefone Café: 06032 938 7445

Start Reg.: 10.30
1. round: 11.00 - 13.00
2. round: 13.45 - 15.45
3. round: 16.00 - 18.00
Final: 18.15 Uhr - 20.15

Additional contest: Most creative deck. Prize: 3 Boosters.

After each round the participants vote for the most creative deck at their table. The deck with the most votes win counted after the preliminary rounds.

Please register or send me an email.

Cheers,
Joscha

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Body:
@ French guys: Hey, cool if you could come. Let me check for local players who could host you.

There is a train going from Frankfurt main station to Bad Nauheim in about half an hour (9.52-10.18). People can pick you up there. Or somebody picks you up in Frankfurt and brings you to Bad Nauheim.

Baron of Frankfurt
